parameters.command:
=cd /opt/ai_video_dubbing && python3 -c "
import sys, json
from step1_download import download_video
url = '{{ $json.video_url }}'
out = download_video(url)
print(json.dumps({'video_path': out, 'video_url': url}))
"

=cd /opt/ai_video_dubbing && python3 -c "
import json
from step2_transcribe import transcribe
video = '{{ $json.video_path }}'
result = transcribe(video)
print(json.dumps(result))
"

=cd /opt/ai_video_dubbing && python3 -c "
import json
from step3_rewrite_dialogue import rewrite_segments
segments = {{ JSON.stringify($json.segments) }}
rewritten = rewrite_segments(segments)
print(json.dumps({'segments': rewritten, 'video_path': '{{ $json.video_path }}', 'video_duration': {{ $json.video_duration }} }))
"

=cd /opt/ai_video_dubbing && python3 -c "
import json
from step4_generate_audio import generate_audio_segments
segments = json.loads('{{ JSON.stringify($json.segments).replace(/'/g, "\\'") }}')
audio_dir = generate_audio_segments(segments)
print(json.dumps({'audio_dir': audio_dir, 'segments': segments, 'video_path': '{{ $json.video_path }}', 'video_duration': {{ $json.video_duration }} }))
"

=SEGMENTS='{{ JSON.stringify($json.segments) }}'
VIDEO='{{ $json.video_path }}'
AUDIO_DIR='{{ $json.audio_dir }}'
TIMESTAMPS_FILE="${AUDIO_DIR}/timestamps.json"

# Crear timestamps JSON desde segmentos
python3 -c "
import json
segs = json.loads('$SEGMENTS'.replace(\"'\", \"\\'\"))
ts = [{'file': f'segment_{str(i+1).zfill(3)}.wav', 'start': s['start']} for i, s in enumerate(segs)]
with open('$TIMESTAMPS_FILE', 'w') as f: json.dump(ts, f)
"

# Ejecutar sync
bash /opt/ai_video_dubbing/n8n_scripts/sync_audio.sh "$VIDEO" "$AUDIO_DIR" "$TIMESTAMPS_FILE" "/opt/ai_video_dubbing/temp/dubbed_raw.mp4"
echo '{"dubbed_video": "/opt/ai_video_dubbing/temp/dubbed_raw.mp4", "video_duration": {{ $json.video_duration }}, "segments": {{ JSON.stringify($json.segments) }} }'
